Mohima

Mhoima Devak Unch Sorgim
ani xanti borea monachea mon'xank sonvsarim.

Sorvespora Deva, sorginchea Raya, sorvpodvedar Deva Bapa,
ami Tuka vakhanntanv,
ami Tuji stuti kortanv, ami Tuka nomoskar kortanv, ami Tuka mhoima ditanv,
Tujea thor voibhova pasot ami Tuka dhin'vastav.

Somia, ekleach zonnit Puta, Jezu Krista, Somia Deva, Devache Xellie,   
Bapachea Puta, Tum sonvsarachem pap kaddtai: amchi kaklut kor.
Tum sonvsarachem pap kaddtai: amchem magnem aikun ghe
Tum Bapachea uzveak boslai: amchi kaklut kor.
Kiteak Povitr Atmea sangatim, Deva Bapache mhoiment, Jezu Kri-  sta,     ekloch Tum Povitr, 

ekloch Tum Somi,
ekloch Tum Bhov Vorto. Aa-amen.

Povitr

Povitr Povitr Povitr
Dolbharancho  Sorvespor Dev
Sorg ani sonvsar  bhorlea 
Tujea voibhovan
Hosanna unch sorgim

Sorvesporache nanvim 
Ieta  to subhagi 
Hosanna unch  sorgim

Proclamation

Save us, Saviour of the world, for by Your Cross and Resurrection You have set us free.

Lamb Of God

Lamb Of God, You take away the sins of the world, have mercy on us
Lamb Of God, You take away the sins of the world, have mercy on us
Lamb Of God, You take away the sins of the world, grant us peace
